/health.note: Worker liveness probe (Railway). Unauthenticated and returns static health JSON.

static.note: Static assets served from packages/worker/public via express.static.

/.note: Root HTML landing page served from packages/worker/views/index.html.

/api/upload.note: Multipart file upload endpoint (multer) that cannot be validated as a single JSON action payload.

/api/pdf.note: Raw PDF binary body endpoints (express.raw application/pdf up to 50mb; app.js:130).
